data.name: Biswajit
data.gender_notes: Biswajit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Biswajit is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Biswa' meaning 'all' and 'Jit' meaning 'conquered'. This name signifies the one who conquers or rules over all aspects of creation. In Hindu mythology, Biswajit is an epithet of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe. The name Biswajit carries the meaning “Lord of all creation” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Biswajit usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of all creation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine power, supreme rule, and cosmic consciousness.
data.etymology: Biswajit belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of all creation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Biswajit total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
